description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteEditor' for creating and editing notes in a note-taking application. It manages note state, auto-saving, and UI rendering.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: React component for editing notes, handling state, save logic, and UI interactions.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving a note, either creating or updating via API.

methods.name: formatLastSaved
methods.description: Formats the last saved timestamp into a human-readable string.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Updates title state and tracks unsaved changes.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Updates content state and tracks unsaved changes.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcut for manual save (Ctrl+S).
